Preconditions: 1. Vendor has an existing profile image and upload is forced to fail
Test Data: Unsupported file type or server-side image upload error
Steps to Execute:
1. Open the profile page

2. Attempt to replace the profile photo

3. Force the upload to fail

4. Refresh the profile page
Expected Result:
- The old photo remains visible

- no broken image is shown

- and the failed upload does not clear existing profile data

Module: Pop-up profile polishing and database integration
Test Title: Partial save failure does not store mixed old and new profile fields
Preconditions: 1. Vendor is logged in and backend returns a failure after the request starts
Test Data: New shop name plus new contact number and forced server error
Steps to Execute:
1. Change multiple profile fields

2. Save while the backend fails midway

3. Reopen the page and inspect the persisted values
Expected Result:
- The profile is either fully saved or fully rejected

- mixed state is not stored

- and the UI matches the final database state

Module: Pop-up profile polishing and database integration
Test Title: Concurrent edits from two sessions resolve to the latest successful save
Preconditions: 1. Vendor profile is open in two browser sessions
Test Data: Session A and Session B editing different fields
Steps to Execute:
1. Update the profile in Session A but do not refresh Session B

2. Save Session A

3. Save Session B with a different field or older value

4. Refresh the page in both sessions
Expected Result:
- The system follows the intended conflict strategy

- the final persisted profile is predictable

- and the user is not left with corrupted merged data

Module: Pop-up profile polishing and database integration
